name: Government of Tunisia
notes: The executive; Minister of Finance Michket Salama Khaldi tabled the 2026 wealth tax.

name: Assemblée des représentants du peuple
notes: 161 seats. Who sits, their bloc and constituency are from the Assembly's own list of blocs (arp.tn), which names about 150 members; the rest show as Vacant. The Assembly publishes blocs, not parties. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Conseil national des régions et des districts
notes: 77 seats. Who sits and their governorate are from the chamber's own member list (cnrd.tn). The list gives no party, so seats are grouped by development region.
